dynamically_batch_jraph_graphs: dynamically batch an iterator of jraph GraphsTuples into variable-sized batches respecting node, edge, and graph count limits
batch_graphs_numpy: batch a sequence of jraph GraphsTuples into a single concatenated GraphsTuple with adjusted sender and receiver offsets
get_graph_size: get the total number of nodes, edges, and graphs from a jraph GraphsTuple
check_graph_batch_size: check if a jraph GraphsTuple exceeds a specified batch size limit for nodes, edges, or graphs
pad_batched_graphs: pad a batched jraph GraphsTuple to fixed dimensions using jraph pad_with_graphs for uniform batch shapes
